name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in static frames better than standard upscalers, giving us a measurable 0.5%+ quality bump on stills without extra compute. The trade-off is a 10% slower render time, but we only run it on keyframes where detail loss hurts most.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal problem, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting 10% render time on a dead end while the blur persists. Test VFI-Flow’s 20% throughput hit instead; if it cuts blur by even 0.5%, that’s the trade-off worth making.
